9323-foliage-various-poems.title: Various Poems
9323-foliage-various-poems.creator: Unknown
9323-foliage-various-poems.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. art has moments wet with tears,  My weakness is they are so few. A GREETING    Good morning, Life--and all  Things glad and beautiful. My pockets nothing hold,  But he that owns the gold,  The Sun, is my great friend--  His spending has no end. Hail to the morning sky,  Which bright clouds measure high;  Hail to you birds whose throats  Would number leaves by notes;  Hail to you shady bowers,  And you green fields of flowers.

arxiv-2107-11150.title: User Preferences and the Shortest Path
arxiv-2107-11150.creator: Isabella Kreller, Bernd Ludwig
arxiv-2107-11150.description: Abstract Indoor navigation systems leverage shortest path algorithms to calculate routes. In order to define the “shortest path”, a cost function has to be specified based on theories and heuristics in the application domain. For the domain of indoor routing, we survey theories and criteria identified in the literature as essential for human path planning.

arxiv-2303-09962.title: Adversarial Counterfactual Visual Explanations
arxiv-2303-09962.creator: Guillaume Jeanneret, Loïc Simon, Frédéric Jurie
arxiv-2303-09962.description: Abstract Counterfactual explanations and adversarial attacks have a related goal: flipping output labels with minimal perturbations regardless of their characteristics. Yet, adversarial attacks cannot be used directly in a counterfactual explanation perspective, as such perturbations are perceived as noise and not as actionable and understandable image modifications.

arxiv-2309-15451.title: On a fully nonlinear elliptic equation with differential forms
arxiv-2309-15451.creator: Hao Fang, Biao Ma
arxiv-2309-15451.description: Abstract . We introduce a fully nonlinear PDE with a differential form, which unifies several important equations in K ​ a ¨ ​ hler \rm{K\ddot{a}hler} geometry including Monge-Ampère equations, J J -equations, inverse σ k \sigma_{k} equations, and the deformed Hermitian Yang-Mills (dHYM) equation.

arxiv-2511-09774.title: Solvaformer: an SE(3) - equivariant graph transformer for small molecule solubility prediction
arxiv-2511-09774.creator: Jonathan Broadbent, Michael Bailey, Mingxuan Li, Abhishek Paul, Louis De Lescure, Paul Chauvin, Lorenzo Kogler-Anele, Yasser Jangjou, Sven Jager
arxiv-2511-09774.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Jonathan Broadbent, Michael Bailey, Mingxuan Li, Abhishek Paul, Louis De Lescure, Paul Chauvin, Lorenzo Kogler-Anele, Yasser Jangjou, Sven Jager. Accurate prediction of small molecule solubility using material-sparing approaches is critical for accelerating synthesis and process optimization, yet experimental measurement is costly and many learning approaches either depend on quantum-derived descriptors or offer limited interpretability. We introduce Solvaformer , a geometry-aware graph transformer that models solutions as multiple molecules with independent S ​ E ​ ( 3 ) SE(3) symmetries.

arxiv-2601-09437.title: A Randomized Milstein Scheme for SDEs with Superlinear Drift Coefficient
arxiv-2601-09437.creator: Sani Biswas * {}^{\mbox{\textasteriskcentered}}
arxiv-2601-09437.description: Abstract . This work presents a randomized-tamed Milstein scheme for stochastic differential equations whose drift coefficient exhibits superlinear growth in the state variable and limited temporal regularity, quantified by β \beta -Hölder continuity with β ∈ ( 0 , 1 ] \beta\in(0,1] .

arxiv-2604-11118.title: Distributionally Robust K-Means Clustering
arxiv-2604-11118.creator: Vikrant Malik, Taylan Kargin, and Babak Hassibi

pmc-11437001.title: Identification of immune patterns in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis patients driven by PLA2G7-positive macrophages using an integrated machine learning survival framework
pmc-11437001.creator: Tianxi Liu, Jingyuan Ning, Xiaoqing Fan, Huan Wei, Guangsen Shi, Qingshan Bill Fu
pmc-11437001.description: Patients with advanced idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF), a complex and incurable lung disease with an elusive pathology, are nearly exclusive candidates for lung transplantation. Improved identification of patient subtypes can enhance early diagnosis and intervention, ultimately leading to better prognostic outcomes for patients. The goal of this study is to identify new immune patterns and biomarkers in patients.

pmc-11621677.title: AI-enabled wearable cameras for assisting dietary assessment in African populations
pmc-11621677.creator: Frank P-W Lo, Jianing Qiu, Modou L Jobarteh, Yingnan Sun, Zeyu Wang, Shuo Jiang, Tom Baranowski, Alex K Anderson, Megan A McCrory, Edward Sazonov, Wenyan Jia, Mingui Sun, Matilda Steiner-Asiedu, Gary Frost, Benny Lo
pmc-11621677.description: We have developed a population-level method for dietary assessment using low-cost wearable cameras. Our approach, EgoDiet, employs an egocentric vision-based pipeline to learn portion sizes, addressing the shortcomings of traditional self-reported dietary methods. To evaluate the functionality of this method, field studies were conducted in London (Study A) and Ghana (Study B) among populations of Ghanaian and Kenyan origin.

pmc-11677670.title: Effect of Transcutaneous Auricular Vagus Nerve Stimulation in Chronic Low Back Pain: A Pilot Study
pmc-11677670.creator: Isabelle Tavares-Figueiredo, Yves-Marie Pers, Claire Duflos, Fanchon Herman, Benjamin Sztajnzalc, Hugo Lecoq, Isabelle Laffont, Arnaud F. Dupeyron, Alexis F. Homs
pmc-11677670.description: Background/Objectives: Chronic low back pain (CLBP) is a common condition with limited long-term treatment options. Vagus nerve stimulation (VNS) has shown potential for pain improvement, but its use in CLBP remains underexplored. Our aim was to evaluate the efficacy, feasibility and tolerability of transcutaneous auricular vagus nerve stimulation (taVNS) in reducing pain and improving functional outcomes in CLBP patients.

pmc-12395432.title: Giant neonatal cystic hygroma with delayed airway obstruction: A case report of emergency surgery in a resource-limited setting
pmc-12395432.creator: Mathayo Shadrack, Helga Naburi, Nimwindael Stephen Msangi, Ibrahim Mkoma, Abbas Musa Mungia, Zaituni Bokhary
pmc-12395432.description: BackgroundCystic hygroma is a rare congenital lymphatic malformation, typically presenting in the cervicofacial region. While large lesions usually cause immediate respiratory distress, delayed airway obstruction can occur, especially in low-resource settings with limited prenatal care and neonatal support.Case presentationA term male neonate was delivered in a rural setting with a large right cervicofacial mass consistent with cystic hygroma.

pmc-12530013.title: Hydrophobic LDH‐Tailored Exfoliated Graphene Sheet Energy Harvester: Harnessing Pressure‐Driven Heating and Electrolysis for Advanced Real Applications
pmc-12530013.creator: Ji Young Park, Seung‐Hwan Lee, Hyo‐Ryoung Lim, Seokhyun Noh, Junho Oh, Han Kim, Da‐Woon Jeong, Yong‐Ho Choa
pmc-12530013.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Hydrovoltaic harvesting converts water–solid interactions into electricity, offering a sustainable power route across diverse settings. Yet most systems are hard to scale, suffer evaporation‐limited lifetimes, and lack multifunctionality, limiting real‐world application. To overcome these limitations, a highly optimized multifunctional hydrovoltaic harvester is developed by integrating exfoliated graphene oxide sheet (EGs) and hydrophobic layered double hydroxide (LDH) coatings onto a porous melamine foam scaffold.

pmc-12563707.title: Exemplar Learning and Memory Retrieval-Based Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm with Engineering Applications
pmc-12563707.creator: Shuying Zhang, Xiaohong Hu, Yue Gao, Minghan Gao, Yufei Zhang
pmc-12563707.description: Particle swarm optimization (PSO) is a bio-inspired stochastic optimization algorithm that simulates the foraging behavior of birds. Despite its simplicity and efficiency, PSO often suffers from premature convergence and a poor balance between exploration and exploitation. These drawbacks mainly arise from its limited learning sources and rigid position update scheme.

pmc-12658850.title: A Case of Mucinous Adenocarcinoma in a Urethral Diverticulum
pmc-12658850.creator: Ryan P Lawson
pmc-12658850.description: Urethral diverticula are uncommon observations encountered in the female pelvis and arise from the posterolateral wall of the urethra. While the pathogenesis of urethral diverticula is unsettled, they are presumably multifactorial, and several theories are addressed in this case report. Various complications are associated with urethral diverticula; however, the feared association is malignant transformation into a diverticular neoplasm.

pmc-13052705.title: Mapping the global prevalence and socioecological drivers of child sexual abuse: a systematic review and synthesis
pmc-13052705.creator: Bipin Adhikari, Aaryan Dahal, Abhijit Mishra, Salum Mshamu, Nipun Shrestha, Lorenz von Seidlein, Frédérique Vallières
pmc-13052705.description: IntroductionChild sexual abuse (CSA) is a widespread global health concern with lasting impacts. CSA is multifactorial and layered, and interventions to tackle CSA require an analysis of the key contributing factors. The main objective of this study was to explore global prevalence estimates of CSA and key contributing factors.

pmc-13173963.title: Finding meaning in the Maze (Out): a co-produced reflexive thematic analysis of patients’ reflection tasks
pmc-13173963.creator: Helene Nygaard Nielsen, Maria Mercedes Guala, Anette Søgaard Nielsen
pmc-13173963.description: BackgroundEating disorders (EDs) are complex psychiatric conditions often marked by difficulties in emotional awareness and self-reflection. Serious games (SGs) are emerging as digital tools that may support patient engagement and insight. Maze Out is a co-produced SG developed for EDs treatment, incorporating in-game reflection tasks.

pmc-13188697.title: Innovative strategies for immune thrombocytopenia treatment: immunomodulatory mechanisms and clinical potential of mesenchymal stem cells
pmc-13188697.creator: Xin Zhou, Ningning Shan
pmc-13188697.description: Immune thrombocytopenia (ITP) is a heterogeneous autoimmune disorder characterized by increased platelet destruction and impaired megakaryopoiesis within a dysregulated bone marrow niche. Conventional therapies often achieve only transient platelet recovery, failing to restore immune tolerance, thereby underscoring the need for mechanism-based therapeutic strategies.

pmc-13260625.title: Quality as an organizational strategy: building a system of improvement
pmc-13260625.creator: David M. Williams, Clifford L. Norman, Lloyd P. Provost
pmc-13260625.description: Improvement science offers proven theories and methods that can be applied to specific projects, but they have rarely been applied to the leadership systems of healthcare organizations. This paper presents Quality as an Organizational Strategy (QOS), a method for building a system of improvement that embeds improvement science into leadership and strategy.

pmc-13268294.title: Effects of a forest therapy camp on cancer survivors’ stress, mood and natural killer cells in Korea
pmc-13268294.creator: Young Ran Chae, Su Youn Park, So Yean Kang, Hyo Young Kang, Sun Hee Lee, Young Mi Jo, In Sun Cheon
pmc-13268294.description: PurposeThis study investigated changes in psychological and physiological indices in cancer survivors who participated in a forest therapy camp in Korea.MethodsA total of 37 cancer survivors (19 and 18 in the experimental and control groups, respectively) participated in this study.

pmc-13627224.title: Establishment of a reference range for hair cortisol using a HPLC-MS/MS method in a Northern Italian population
pmc-13627224.creator: Federico Fortuna, Alessia Lanno, Davide Magrin, Amelia Locatelli, Diego Gonzalez, Dario Jacobsen, Juan Jamardo, Bibiana Fabre, Alice Passoni, Renzo Bagnati
pmc-13627224.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). PurposeHair cortisol concentration (HCC) represents a promising biomarker for long-term hypothalamic–pituitary–adrenal (HPA) axis activity. However, its routine clinical application is currently limited by the lack of well-established reference ranges. We aimed to establish population-based reference intervals for HCC in healthy adults from Northern Italy, using a liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS) method following the Clinical and Laboratory Standards Institute (CLSI) EP28-A3c guidelines.MethodsHair samples were collected from 256 healthy volunteers selected using strict inclusion and exclusion criteria.
